title: DeepMisconceptionProcessEventSchema
description: Schema for Modality 3: Chronological Coding-Process Events

session_id.description: Identifier linking to the parent session

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this chronological event

timestamp.description: Monotonically increasing chronological timestamp in ISO-8601 format

event_description.description: Human-readable description of the developer action

characters_inserted.description: Count of characters inserted in this event

characters_deleted.description: Count of characters removed in this event

code_snapshot_reference.description: Hash or version reference of code state at this event

execution_result.description: Outcome of an execution or test run

error_type.description: Python exception type or 'none' if no error occurred

debug_action.description: Action taken to diagnose or resolve an error or 'none'

test_result.description: Result of automated or manual test case evaluation
